name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme
description: PMFME provides financial, technical and business support for setting up or upgrading micro food processing enterprises.
eligibility: Supports new or existing micro food processing enterprises.
Individual beneficiaries can receive credit-linked capital subsidy subject to scheme conditions.
SHGs, FPOs and cooperatives can receive support under applicable components.
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost for eligible individual units, subject to a maximum of Rs. 10 lakh per unit.
Support for common infrastructure is available under applicable components.
SHG members can receive seed capital support under applicable conditions.
required_documents: Applicant and project documents as specified by the current PMFME application process.
application_process: Check eligibility on the official PMFME portal.
Submit the application through the prescribed PMFME process.
Loan-linked support is subject to project and lender approval.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: PMEGP supports new self-employment ventures and micro enterprises to generate employment in rural and urban areas.
eligibility: Individual beneficiaries must be above 18 years of age.
There is no income ceiling for assistance for setting up projects under PMEGP.
For projects above Rs. 10 lakh in manufacturing or above Rs. 5 lakh in business or service, the beneficiary should have at least VIII standard pass qualification.
Only one person from one family is eligible for financial assistance for setting up a new enterprise.
benefits: Provides credit-linked financial assistance for eligible new micro enterprises.
required_documents: Applicant and project documents required by the official PMEGP application process.
application_process: Apply through the official PMEGP portal.
Submit the prescribed application and project information.
Project appraisal and financing are subject to the implementing agency and lending institution.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
description: PMMY provides institutional collateral-free credit to eligible micro and small businesses and individuals for income-generating activities. It covers manufacturing, trading and service activities, including activities allied to agriculture such as dairy, poultry and beekeeping. Both term loan and working capital requirements can be met.
eligibility: Eligible individuals and micro or small businesses can seek credit for permitted income-generating activities.
Permitted activities include manufacturing, trading, services and activities allied to agriculture such as dairy, poultry and beekeeping.
Loan approval is subject to the lending institution's assessment and applicable PMMY conditions.
benefits: Shishu loans are up to Rs. 50,000.
Kishor loans are above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.
Tarun loans are above Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.
Tarun Plus loans are above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh for eligible entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun-category loan.
Collateral is not required under PMMY.
required_documents: Documents vary by lending institution and borrower profile.
Applicants should confirm current requirements with the participating lender.
application_process: Approach an eligible participating lending institution.
Submit the required borrower and business information.
Loan sanction is subject to lender appraisal and applicable PMMY conditions.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
description: The Startup India Seed Fund Scheme provides financial assistance to eligible early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialization through eligible incubators.
eligibility: The startup must satisfy the DPIIT recognition requirements.
The startup must satisfy the incorporation-age requirement specified by the current scheme guidelines.
The business idea should have potential for market fit, viable commercialization and scaling.
Applicants must verify current eligibility requirements on the official portal.
benefits: Financial assistance can support proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialization.
Selected startups receive funding through eligible incubators.
required_documents: Startup and application documents required by the official SISFS application process.
application_process: Apply through the official Startup India Seed Fund Scheme portal when applications are available.
Applications are evaluated according to the scheme process.
Selected startups receive funding through eligible incubators.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PM-KISAN provides income support to eligible land-holding farmer families according to the scheme guidelines.
eligibility: The scheme provides support to eligible land-holding farmer families as defined by the scheme.
State and UT administrations identify eligible farmer families according to scheme guidelines.
Exclusion categories apply and must be checked on the official PM-KISAN portal.
benefits: Eligible farmer families receive income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments.
required_documents: Applicants should check the official PM-KISAN portal for current requirements.
application_process: Use the official PM-KISAN portal for registration and status checking.
Complete the required identity and farmer information verification.
Check the official portal for current eligibility and exclusion rules.
